query:
INSERT INTO post (thread_id, board_id, author_id, subject, body, created_at)
               SELECT t.id, t.board_id, $1, '', $2, $3 FROM thread t
               WHERE t.id = $4
                 AND ($5::BIGINT IS NULL
                      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM post WHERE author_id = $1 AND created_at >= $6) < $5)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
